newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt Breweries with 7.5 pound payout.
newsitem.headline: Egypt Breweries with 7.5 pound payout.

text.p: Egypt's sole beer manufacturer Pyramids Breweries will pay a 7.503 pound ($2.207) dividend for the 1995/96 financial year, results published on Saturday showed.
The financial year ends on June 30 and comparitive dividends for 1994/95 were not available.
The state sold 74.9 percent -- or 3.37 million shares -- in Pyramids Breweries to six international funds for 231 million pounds earlier this year. Shares were sold for 68.5 pounds each.

The state privatised about 15 percent of the company's 4.5 million shares in July. It had planned to sell 20 percent of the firm's equity but religious opposition to the firm's alcoholic product line undermined the deal.
The firm made net distributable profits for 1995/96 of 44.87 million pounds compared to 42.98 million in the previous year.
These profit figures were slightly higher than results made available earlier in the year which put 1995/96 profits at 42.980 million, up from 31.654 million in 1994/95.
Pre-tax profits for 1995/96 were lower at 62.51 million from 65.82 million in the previous year.
Shares closed unchanged on Thursday at 70.00 pounds.
